Our Mission

## What We Do

BioNova builds modular, smart, farm-ready biodigesters that convert manure and food waste into biogas, electricity, and high-value bio-fertilizer. Our compact systems are built from smart, durable materials and come with an IoT app so farmers can monitor output, savings, and system health from anywhere.

In short: **Clean energy + new revenue + remote control** Purpose-built for farms.

## Why BioNova Is Different

### Designed for Farmers

Compact footprint, manure-first design, and easy access to service points. Works on small and mid-size farms without civil-engineering headaches.

### Up to 3× more affordable

We use cost-efficient, corrosion-resistant materials and optimized fabrication to cut CAPEX, without compromising durability.

### LEGO-Style Setup

Ships as pre-fabricated modules with quick-connect piping and color-coded ports. Most installs are done in days, not weeks.

### Full App Control

Monitor gas, electricity, and fertilizer production, track savings, plan maintenance, and get alerts, from any device, anywhere.

Lower up-front cost

Faster commissioning

Data-driven ROI

Easy maintenance

## The BioNova App

Every BioNova unit ships with our monitoring & analytics app. Farmers see real-time production, savings, uptime and can share reports with co-ops, banks, and partners.

*   Biogas, electricity & fertilizer dashboards
*   Smart alerts for pH, temperature & feed rate
*   Savings & revenue tracking
*   Secure cloud access from any device

## Pricing

Hardware at production price. We earn when you earn, not before.

### Revenue-Sharing Model

We sell every digester **at production price**, no markup. Our income comes from collecting and selling your bio-fertilizer, then sharing the revenue with you. **You keep 100% of your electricity revenue.**
